basics.name: Emad Gohari
basics.headline: Senior Machine Learning Engineer · ML Systems, NLP, GenAI

summary: Senior machine learning engineer with **8 years of experience** delivering ML, NLP, and LLM systems from research to production. At Thomson Reuters Labs, built **reproducible training pipelines and PII-isolated infrastructure**, shipped **production GenAI summarization and semantic search**, and contributed agent configuration and evaluation tooling to a commercially launched AI product. Collaborates with researchers, domain experts, and product engineers.

items: Model Training & Evaluation (F1 Score, ROC-AUC, MRR, MAP, Recall@k)

experience.description: Built ML systems at TR Labs for CLEAR's KYC/AML screening and investigations, and Checkpoint tax research. Worked with researchers, domain experts, and product engineers on data infrastructure and customer-facing features.

projects.name: Model Retraining & Experimentation Pipelines: CLEAR
projects.description: Designed, implemented, and tested an **on-demand SageMaker retraining pipeline**, turning researchers' feature-generation, training, and evaluation code into reusable DAG steps. Enabled **parallel experiments tracked in MLflow**, cutting researcher time per round by an **estimated ~40%**. Extended reusable Python/PySpark components; built **Snowflake processing and training proofs of concept** and assessed migration gaps.

projects.name: GenAI Report Summarization: CLEAR Business AI
projects.description: Built an LLM summarization workflow **live in production processing hundreds of reports daily**, with selective XML extraction and targeted per-section calls. Integrated **Bing Search, LLM verification, and source links** to reduce same-name entity mismatches. Refined extraction and prompts through SME reviews; compared **GPT-4 and Claude Sonnet on quality, latency, and cost** to inform model selection.

projects.name: Entity Resolution Data Infrastructure: CLEAR KYC/AML
projects.description: Built research infrastructure for an entity-resolution system spanning **~800M entities and billions of documents**. Designed a **PII-isolated SageMaker/CloudFormation environment** with researcher-specific profiles; defined a **versioned JSON schema** reconciling two annotation sources with Spark/Python normalization, merging, and conflict checks; and automated manual runs into **scheduled SageMaker Pipelines**.

projects.name: Agent Configuration & Evaluation: CLEAR Investigate
projects.description: Contributed to **commercially launched CLEAR Investigate**. Built a central PydanticAI layer for prompts, tool descriptions/availability, and agent/subagent wiring, enabling **agent reconfiguration from one place**. Migrated existing **LLM-as-judge tooling** into a repository for reuse and future CI/CD integration.

projects.name: Semantic Search Query Understanding: Checkpoint
projects.description: Shipped a **sentence-embedding query-intent classifier** separating broad conceptual queries from specific tax lookups to promote higher-level documents. **Improved access to conceptual documents by 95%** within a **~100ms latency budget**, addressing a retrieval gap identified with SMEs and customer feedback.

experience.description: Built NLP systems across data preparation, training, evaluation, and application integration with research partners. Trained domain-specific Word2Vec embeddings and LSTM NLU models with interpretability testing.

projects.name: Transformer Fine-Tuning for Question Generation
projects.description: Fine-tuned **T5 in PyTorch/Hugging Face** to generate questions from documents, **cutting manual data-curation effort by 40%**. Experimented with input representations and evaluated output using BLEURT with university research partners.

projects.name: Conversational Question Answering with NLP & LSTM Models
projects.description: Developed **conversational question answering** combining document analysis and **LSTM-based text tagging**. Used semi-automatically generated ontologies to interpret questions and intent; experimented with knowledge graphs in an industry research collaboration.
